subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: For empty plugin-scope and gateway reloads, should the agent harness registry preserve all previously registered harnesses, preserve only bundled or always-on provider harnesses, or clear plugin-owned harnesses strictly with the plugin scope?
rationale: Current main still clears the registry on empty-scope paths, while the open candidate PR restores all prior harnesses; that fixes the reported delivery failures but may conflict with plugin disablement and ownership semantics.

options.title: Use owner-aware preservation
options.body: Preserve bundled or lifecycle-owned provider harnesses across empty-scope reloads while still clearing plugin-owned harnesses when their plugin is disabled or out of scope.

options.title: Preserve all harnesses
options.body: Accept the open PR's broader semantics if stability across empty scopes is more important than strict plugin-scope isolation for agent harnesses.

options.title: Keep strict clearing
options.body: Keep empty-scope clearing semantics and solve the user-visible failure through readiness, retry, or doctor/config repair instead.

recommendation.title: Use owner-aware preservation
recommendation.body: Preserve bundled or lifecycle-owned provider harnesses across empty-scope reloads while still clearing plugin-owned harnesses when their plugin is disabled or out of scope.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin-scope and harness-selection history makes this the strongest routing signal for the lifecycle contract decision.
